basis: User approved stable-empty candidate with dynamic presence/nearest controls, after StateRecovery003; G03/G05 and handoff separation of maintenance from plasticity.

criteria.clean_lifecycle: Each seed: all endpoint known/UNKNOWN/focus scores>=95%, accepted writes and exact clears>=95%. No seed excluded.
criteria.comparative: Additional contraction must earn benefit against same-curriculum replay; local map must preserve populated memories, not just UNKNOWN. Simple nearest and protected metadata remain in tables.
criteria.decision: Keep, revise named deficit, reject within scope, or identify missing measurement. No automatic adoption or production claim.
criteria.nominal_noise_joint: At.15 over five1024-round phases: every phase endpoint known and UNKNOWN>=95%, all immediate legitimate focus writes>=95%, and>=95% streams have EVERY read correct. Report all conditions, not pooled recall alone.

development: Seven fits9900steps on141only, including preserved failures; see DEVELOPMENT_FINDINGS.md.

evaluation.attenuated_write: Predeclared post-admission payload delivery fault: empty->value and old->new, delivered state mixture alpha.05/.1/.25/.5/.75/1, read0/1/4/16. NOT low qualification score. Presence updated because write was accepted.
evaluation.extended: 4096noise rounds at.15 while focus empty and neighbors populated; legitimate first write and256further rounds.
evaluation.global_clear: All addresses cleared and read at0/1/128, with same vector noise.
evaluation.lifecycle: 64streams x4addresses.2established neighboring records. Focus address follows empty->write->correction->clear->rewrite. Each phase1024 fresh noise rounds, vector sigma0/.15/.3. Read every round; record0/1/16/64/256/1024.
evaluation.local_dynamics: Finite-difference Jacobian around settled8known codes andEMPTY; eps.001/.0001. Local only, no global proof.
evaluation.metadata_fault: Flip presence only: established marked absent or empty marked present; .15noise1024rounds; then corrective write/clear. Does not alter neural weights.
evaluation.shock: 256four-address streams, Gaussian.5/1.0; rounds0/1/4/16/128. Known andempty separately.
evaluation.writes: Full correct value code installed on explicit qualified score>=.5 with matching scope. Tested .5001 accepted/.4999 rejected/wrong scope score1 rejected. These are exact event contracts, not weak analog write learning.

new_arms.contract: Same initialization/data/steps as replay, plus sampled local empty contraction loss.
new_arms.local_empty: Freeze the2128-parameter parent and fit one positive radius: F(z)=[1-exp(-||z||²/r²)]F_parent(z). No persistent existence bit. Uses EMPTY=0 and known code scale.
new_arms.replay: Continue2128 parameters with balanced starts, chronic/variable-depth teaching and fixedpoint code anchors.

presence: Dynamic boolean per address,4raw bytes per stream; updated on supplied writes/clears, unaffected by vector noise. Explicit metadata-flip challenges test this assumption.
purpose: Stable writable absence, known retention, correction, clear and reuse; bounded fixed-weight maintenance study, not integrated tri-core or learning-rule research.
resource_budget: One CPU torch thread,15mainfits x1800steps; no model downloads, private data, external writes or deployment. Weightsfloat32. Target device, energy, full temporary memory peak unmeasured.
source: Frozen16D representations from HorizonBinding002 and frozen1,800-step recurrent parents from StateRecovery003. Exact source hashes packaged.

training.fairness: Same paired training observations/targets and optimizer steps; not FLOPs/wall time/trainable parameters; inherited preparation separately counted.
training.loss: Mean(code MSE+.2 frozen-head CE) over rounds +2 exact-prototype fixedpoint MSE; contract only adds .5*mean(relu(||F(eps)||²/||eps||²-.64)). All evaluate the same32 probes, per-coordinate sigma uniform .02–.25.
training.optimizer: AdamW weight_decay.0001; replay/contract lr.0015,local_empty lr.01; grad norm limit1.
training.targets: Direct correct labels and full numerical code targets; all supplied. Not spontaneous learning.
